mapper.select: SELECT id, tenant_id, task_id, project_id, plan_revision_id, plan_revision_no, assessment_id, assessment_version, checklist_id, checklist_version, grade_code, initiator_user_id, initiator_project_scope_version, source_snapshot_version, status_code, hold_reason_code, current_node_no, previous_approval_instance_id, replacement_approval_instance_id, decide_time, rejection_reason, withdraw_user_id, withdraw_time, withdraw_reason, version, creator, create_time, updater, update_time, deleted, lead_time_enabled_flag, source_task_version, source_plan_version, source_cutover_type_code, source_network_mode_code, source_schedule_time, lead_rule_version, lead_timezone_id, lead_plan_submit_time, lead_required_days, lead_actual_natural_days, lead_late_submission_flag, project_version, project_code, project_name, customer_id, customer_code, customer_name, department_id, department_code, department_name, project_scope_version FROM cut_approval_instance WHERE tenant_id = #{query.tenantId} AND task_id = #{query.taskId} AND replacement_approval_instance_id IS NULL AND deleted = b'0' ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE cut_approval_instance SET status_code = #{query.statusCode}, current_node_no = #{query.currentNodeNo}, decide_time = #{query.decisionAt}, rejection_reason = #{query.rejectionReason}, replacement_approval_instance_id = #{query.replacementApprovalInstanceId}, hold_reason_code = #{query.holdReasonCode}, version = #{query.expectedVersion} + 1, updater = #{query.updater}, update_time = #{query.updateTime} WHERE tenant_id = #{query.tenantId} AND id = #{query.approvalInstanceId} AND version = #{query.expectedVersion} AND deleted = b'0'
